verdicts.human_summary: The reset action should be gated behind a configurable prop/parameter (e.g., allowReset or docs.disableReset) so users can opt out per-story, per-component, or globally, rather than always being wired for every inline canvas.
verdicts.reasoning: No AI comment addresses the need for user-facing configurability/opt-out of the reset button. AI Comment 3 is the closest, noting unnecessary state when inline is false, but that's about code efficiency for non-inline cases, not about providing a configurable mechanism for inline canvas users to disable the reset feature.
